name: bay_issue
input_text: Current photo of one warehouse rack bay (pick faces and cartons), taken by a fixed camera or the patrol drone.
instructions: Compare the current bay photo with how the bay should look. What is the main issue with this bay right now?
reference_text: Reference photo of this same bay when correctly stocked and labelled:

choices.description: Bay matches its expected state: pick faces stocked, cartons in place, labels readable.
Every pick face still has some stock, but one or more are clearly depleted (roughly a quarter full or less).
At least one whole pick face or beam level that should hold stock (stocked in the reference) has no cartons at all; the rest of the bay may be fine.

An extra or wrong carton or pallet is present where it should not be: in the wrong slot, overhanging, rotated, on the floor, or from another product family. A gap with nothing in it is empty, not misplaced.
A location or product label is missing, damaged, covered or unreadable.
Something blocks the bay or aisle in front of it: debris, a trolley, a person, spilled goods.
A problem not covered above, or the photo is too blurred or dark to judge.
